# LibreOffice Writer GUI Interface

## Window Header

- **Application Title Bar**
  - Left: "LibreOffice Writer" icon
  - Center: "Untitled 1.docx - LibreOffice Writer"
  - Right: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons

- **System Information Bar**
  - Center: "Oct 22 20:02"
  - Right: System tray icons (including bell icon)

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Items**
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

## Toolbar

- **Quick Access Toolbar**
  - New Document
  - Open Document
  - Save Document
  - Save As
  - Print
  - Undo
  - Redo

- **Formatting Toolbar**
  - Paragraph Style dropdown: "Default Paragraph Style"
  - Font dropdown: "Liberation Serif"
  - Font Size dropdown: "12 pt"
  - Bold (B)
  - Italic (I)
  - Underline (U)
  - Strikethrough (S)
  - Superscript (A^)
  - Subscript (A_)
  - Font Color
  - Highlight Color
  - Text Alignment (Left, Center, Right, Justify)
  - Numbered List
  - Bulleted List
  - Indentation Controls
  - More Formatting Options

## Notification Bar

- **First Notification**
  - Icon: Information icon (blue circle with "i")
  - Text: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
  - Buttons: "Get involved" (button) and "X" (close button)

- **Second Notification**
  - Icon: Information icon (blue circle with "i")
  - Text: "Your donations support our worldwide community."
  - Buttons: "Donate" (button) and "X" (close button)

## Document Area

- **Page Layout**
  - White page with default margins
  - Page number indicator: "Page 1 of 1"
  - Word count: "0 words, 0 characters"
  - Page style: "Default Page Style"
  - Language: "English (Hong Kong)"

- **Ruler**
  - Horizontal ruler with measurement markings (1 to 18)
  - Vertical ruler with measurement markings (not visible in detail)

## Sidebar

- **Vertical Scroll Bar**
  - Located on the right side of the document area
  - Includes a scroll thumb and arrow buttons

- **Sidebar Icons (Visible)**
  - **Document Properties Icon** (orange square with document icon)
  - **Styles Icon** (purple square with style icon)
  - **Master Page Icon** (blue circle with page icon)
  - **Page Layout Icon** (white square with layout icon)
  - **Object Properties Icon** (gray square with object icon)

## Status Bar

- **Left Section**
  - Page number: "Page 1 of 1"
  - Word count: "0 words, 0 characters"

- **Center Section**
  - Page style: "Default Page Style"

- **Right Section**
  - Language: "English (Hong Kong)"
  - Zoom level: "100%"
  - Zoom control: Minus, slider, plus buttons

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Dock**
  - Application icons:
    - Google Chrome
    - Thunderbird
    - Visual Studio Code
    - VLC Media Player
    - LibreOffice Writer
    - LibreOffice Calc
    - LibreOffice Impress
    - GIMP
    - File Manager
    - Software Center
    - Help
    - Trash

- **Bottom Dock**
  - Grid icon for application launcher

## Additional UI Elements

- **Document View**
  - Blank document with cursor at top-left corner
  - No text or content present

- **Cursor**
  - Text cursor (I-beam) at the top-left corner of the document

- **Document Properties**
  - No visible document properties panel

- **Page Setup**
  - No visible page setup dialog

- **Print Preview**
  - No visible print preview

- **Spell Check**
  - No visible spell check dialog

- **Find and Replace**
  - No visible find and replace dialog

- **Track Changes**
  - No visible track changes dialog

- **Comments**
  - No visible comments panel

- **Version Control**
  - No visible version control panel

- **Document History**
  - No visible document history panel

- **Document Security**
  - No visible document security panel

- **Document Permissions**
  - No visible document permissions panel

- **Document Metadata**
  - No visible document metadata panel

- **Document Tags**
  - No visible document tags panel
